alternatives.transcript: An agency task is an internal to do item, and the important word is attached. A task is not a floating note in a list somewhere. It hangs directly off a prospect, a lead, an opportunity, an application, any of the other objects in this library. There are zero tasks at the moment, which again tells you something honest about where the team is. But the design is the thing worth understanding because it is the difference between a business that follows up and a business that means two. Three fields, and all three are load bearing. The title is what the work is, written so that somebody who was not in the room understands it in two seconds. The status tells you whether it is still to do, in progress, blocked, or done. And that is what lets anybody glance at a record and see the real real state of it. The assignee is the named human who is doing it. Drop the assignee, and you have a wish. Drop the status, and you have a note. With all three, you have a commitment with a name on it. Why insist that follow-up work lives next to the record rather than in a separate list? Because separate lists are where work goes to die. Somebody writes call this shop back on Thursday in a notes app. Thursday arrives. Nobody can remember which shop. The deal goes cold and nobody can even explain why. When the task hangs off the prospect record, then opening the prospect tells you exactly what still needs doing and who owns it. You cannot look at a live deal without seeing the outstanding work attached to it. So where does this get used day to day? In the five second check before anything is dropped. A call goes badly, so a task appears on the lead to call back Thursday. An advert goes live, so a task appears on the content record to check the rankings in two weeks. An application comes in, so a task appears to reply. That is it. That is the entire life cycle. There are no tasks at the moment, which I would read as an opportunity rather than a problem, because the first genuinely useful thing anybody does in a system like this is a task a task to the record they were already looking at. Then the pipeline starts telling the truth.
